dict.string: Notch measures low, mid, and high frequency magnitudes in the output mix for the real-time waveform, and reads an app's audio when you change it in the mixer. Samples are processed in memory, never recorded or stored.
Notch communicates with Music and Spotify to read the current track when system now-playing data is unavailable.
Notch lists your paired Bluetooth audio devices so you can connect them from the audio screen.
Notch needs full calendar access to display a scrolling timeline of the next 24 hours and detect meeting links.
Notch shows your upcoming events and meeting join links in the notch timeline.

Notch shows a live preview from your camera so you can check yourself before a call, and reads your face during a Face ID scan to unlock your Mac. The preview runs only while that screen is open, the scan only while it is looking for a face — and frames are processed in memory, never written to disk.
Notch watches your Desktop for new screenshots so it can announce them at the notch. Listing that folder reads file names and dates — never the contents of your files.
Only used if you have pointed screenshot saving at your Documents folder: Notch watches it for new screenshots to announce at the notch. File names and dates only — never the contents of your files.
Notch watches your Downloads folder so a finished download can be announced at the notch. Listing that folder reads file names and dates — never the contents of your files.
Notch uses your approximate location to show the current weather in the notch header.
Notch uses your approximate location to show the current weather in the notch header.
